:::{#thm-epe-decomposition}
#### Bias, variance and noise

Let $\mean$ be the [mean function](#def-mean-function) of the outcome given the covariate.
Suppose that, given $\newpredvar = \predvar$,
the new outcome is $\newoutvar = \mean(\predvar) + \noise$,
where $\noise$, the noise in the outcome at $\predvar$, has mean $0$ and variance $\varpar$,
and that $\newoutvar$ is independent of the random training set $\trainset$,
and that $\E{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}^2} < \infty$.
Then the [expected prediction error at $\predvar$](#def-epe)
is the squared [bias](#def-prediction-bias)
of the prediction $\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}$, used as an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) of $\mean(\predvar)$,
plus its [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance),
plus $\varpar$:

$$
\epe{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\predvar} = \sqf{\bias{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}}
+ \Var{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}} + \varpar.
$$ {#eq-epe-decomposition}

:::

::: proof

Every expectation below is conditional on $\newpredvar = \predvar$, as in the exercises.
By @sol-epe-split-noise, the expected squared prediction error is the noise variance plus the pMSE of the prediction, used as an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) of $\mean(\predvar)$.
By @sol-epe-split-bias, that pMSE is the squared bias plus the variance.
Substituting @eq-epe-after-bias into @eq-epe-after-noise:

$$
\ba
\epe{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\predvar}
&= \varpar + \E{\sqf{\mean(\predvar) - \fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}}
&& \text{(separating the noise)} \\
&= \varpar + \sqf{\bias{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}} + \Var{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}
&& \text{(separating the bias)} \\
&= \sqf{\bias{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}} + \Var{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}} + \varpar
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}
\ea
$$

:::
